headline: Netflix releases trailer for FTX scandal series 'The Altruists'
summary: Netflix released a trailer for 'The Altruists,' a series dramatizing the rise and fall of FTX and featuring a fictionalized Sam Bankman-Fried. The show is set to premiere on November 19.

claims.statement: Netflix released a trailer for 'The Altruists,' a series about the FTX scandal.
